notes: L0 registry of DECISION models only (Decision Index 0.3 entrants with identifiable weights or hosts are included, most as community_finetune or third_party_board_only). Join key for pricing, performance, capabilities and caveats.

General LLM baselines are NOT listed here: model strings resolve against this file first, then data/model-catalog/models.json (ids + aliases). Rows for baselines used by sources (Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Luna, Haiku 4.5, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Qwen3.8-27B, GPT-6 Astra, ...) reference the model-catalog id. Baselines that model-catalog lacks (gpt-5-nano, qwen3.6-27b, qwen3.5-4b, terra/luna/sol versions on TypeSafe Evals) are recorded in the missing[] of the document that uses them.

Harness-suffixed score ids (model@harness) resolve to the base id. Aliases include API ids, OpenRouter ids, @cf ids and Hugging Face repos; provider-qualified router ids (sference/clef, cloudflare/clef) are aliases so a row can keep its serving provider.

params_total is the Hugging Face safetensors total when a repo count was read (Clef, Clef-flash, Perplexity) and otherwise the Decision Index served_params, which uses the base-model figure; each model note says which. null means unknown.

status third_party_board_only = known only from a board or listing (no first-party docs or no identifiable weights). community_finetune = open weights from an independent author. Licenses are the Hugging Face cardData field, not verified against LICENSE files.

models.notes: TypeSafe hosted System One model (RLCD-trained). Weights closed; same weights serve every account (no fine-tuning). Aliases jev-latest and jev-preview both pointed to jev-1.13.0 on 2026-10-07 (docs: "There is no preview build available right now."). Released 2026-09-15 as early access (launch blog); OpenRouter lists typesafe/jev-1.13 as created 2026-09-17/18. jev-1.12 appears only in the parallel-questions cookbook. Base model and parameter count are not disclosed. Also on Requesty (typesafe/jev-latest); Vercel AI Gateway listing reported by a third party only. Official price page: docs.typesafe.ai/models (not jevaihub.com).

Cloudflare Workers AI decision model: frozen Qwen3.8-27B backbone + vision encoder + joint schema head with rank-256 LoRA (blog); prefill-only. params_total is the HF safetensors total (27,356,728,560); the Cloudflare label is 27B and the Decision Index lists served_params 27.8B (base-model figure). HF repos created 2026-09-30; launch 2026-10-01. Open weights, Apache-2.0; training data and pipeline not published. Hosted on Workers AI (@cf/cloudflare/clef; body model field must be "clef"), OpenRouter, Requesty and sference (EU, <=16 questions). Needs about 54 GB VRAM in bf16 (independent report). RL fine-tuning service is design-partner only.

9B sibling of Clef (Qwen3.5-9B base; HF safetensors total 9,409,813,744; Decision Index served_params 9.65B). A different product from the 27B Clef: weaker on out-of-scope (CLINC150+OOS 66.77 vs 97.43 on Cloudflare card) and on the independent Nicia admission task. Same Workers AI schema, 64K context, <=64 questions.

Successor of v1; noncausal full-attention mode. HF repo created 2026-10-05. Rank 1 on the Decision Index 0.3 Full score (62.75). Not on OpenRouter or Requesty at retrieval. Liquid AI decision model, public API (POST https://api.liquid.ai/decisions/v1/systemone; console key) plus free tier d1:free (text-only). Launched around 2026-09-29; OpenRouter created 2026-10-01. Docs: "Each question is charged for its text and all supplied images" (state may be billed per question; unverified).

Upstage beta ("Solar Decide is in beta"). Choice max 26 options (single-token labels A-Z; 422 beyond). 524,288-token context on OpenRouter. Parameter count is only in a third-party search summary (35B total / 3B active) and is not stored. Korean strength per Upstage.
Known only from the OpenRouter free listing (created 2026-09-30, 32,768-token context). No Inception first-party docs found. Listing text says "It makes up to 14 decisions per second" (unit unclear).

Respan behavior scorer for AI traces (per behavior: present / absent / not_observable probabilities). Marketed as a behavior classifier, not a general typed-decision model; included because OpenRouter lists it in the decisions modality.
Free Lite tier of Span-01 on OpenRouter (also a :free route). Highest OpenRouter decision-request volume after Jev in the rankings page.
